g.text: LLM never grades its own output
◀ ── IF ACTION ≠ DONE: Next Observation Loop (Updated Facts & State Ledger) ──
• If Action == DONE: Terminal state reached ➔ Local TTS speaks confirmation to developer ➔ Session gracefully completes
• Anti-Oscillation Guard: If the same 16-char SHA-256 error signature repeats ≥ 3 times, the circuit breaker automatically halts and requests human clarification.
